title: Paired engineering embeds software builders directly beside frontline domain doers
text: To convert tacit delivery knowledge into durable software assets, engineering teams cannot build in isolation from specifications. AI-native services require paired engineering: embedding software engineers alongside domain practitioners who execute the actual work. Every human correction, rework cycle, and edge-case exception is captured at the operational boundary and converted directly into evaluation suites and automation logic.
qualification: Practitioner staffing and organizational pattern; requires cross-functional cultural alignment and deliberate investment in internal tooling rather than immediate billable utilization.

public_locator.value: Pair engineering: pairing builders (software engineers) directly with doers (domain experts) in the same operational loop to codify tacit delivery knowledge.
